description: This bar chart illustrates the ColeG-R (%) metric for three different LLaMA model sizes—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four distinct training conditions, as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis displays the model sizes in ascending order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the ColeG-R (%) metric, scaled linearly from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each model size, four bars are grouped together, each corresponding to a different training condition: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (light red with diagonal stripes). Visually, for each model size, the bars generally increase in height from left to right, indicating that adding more datasets to the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) process tends to improve the ColeG-R score. The tallest bars, representing the highest ColeG-R (%) values, are for the LLaMA-2-70B model under the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” condition, reaching approximately 95%. The shortest bars, for the LLaMA-2-7B model under the “no SFT” condition, are around 70%. All bars are presented without any special visual emphasis such as shading or bolding, and the chart does not show any explicit sorting of the bars beyond their natural grouping by model size.
